prompt.text:
Create a standard-library-only text utility module in `solution.rs`. Expose:

- `pub fn tuple_fields(value: &(i32, bool, String)) -> (i32, bool, &str)`
- `pub fn is_below_five(value: i32) -> bool`
- `pub fn countdown(start: u32) -> Vec<String>`
- `pub fn append_and_measure(text: String, suffix: &str) -> (String, usize)`
- `pub fn first_word(text: &str) -> &str`

`tuple_fields` must borrow its input and return the three fields without mutation. `is_below_five` uses a strict comparison. `countdown(0)` returns only `"LIFTOFF!"`; otherwise it returns `"N!"` from `start` down to 1 followed by `"LIFTOFF!"`. `append_and_measure` takes ownership, appends the suffix exactly once, and reports the resulting UTF-8 byte length. `first_word` skips leading Unicode whitespace and returns the first maximal non-whitespace slice; it returns `""` for empty or all-whitespace input. It must return a slice of the original string and must not allocate or mutate it.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
